data.universe: same 37 primary single-class securities from PV1

feature_quality_gate.rule: every feature passing both gates is included; performance cannot exclude a feature

features.fcf_growth: (OCF-capex) current/(OCF-capex) prior-1; OCF and capex exact same start/end; both FCF >0; comparable YTD/FY only

gates.P5: D10 and spread positive after every robustness removal
gates.P7: base cost leaves D10 and spread positive

groups.deciles: same deterministic PV1 framework, D10 highest growth

hypothesis: higher PIT comparable-period fundamental growth predicts higher 63-session SPY excess return

discrete: quarter: 70..110 days, form 10-Q/10-Q-A, fiscal period Q1/Q2/Q3
annual: 300..400 days, form 10-K/10-K-A, fiscal period FY
periods.prior_match: same fiscal period/family/unit/tag priority; end difference 345..385 days; duration difference <=7 days quarter/YTD and <=15 annual

robustness: remove top 10 issuers by positive contribution

score.formula: equal-weight mean of every quality-passing feature rank

verdict.UNPROMISING: P8 PASS and <=1 of P1..P4 PASS
